interface.longDescription: Routes complex reasoning through explicit route families and a conditional stage machine: intake, route, frame, decompose, operate, test, evidence/world, integrate, closure, and delivery. Failure signatures select operators inside stages rather than acting as the whole workflow. Every stage has an entry gate, guardrails, exit test, and handoff; satisfied stages may be skipped, failed dependencies trigger repair at the earliest stage. Retains semantic descent, orientation-bundle and umbrella mapping, provenance/transport controls, world-remap, interaction discipline, formalization gates, dual closure, and APA academic citation controls. Includes a task-intent boundary: invoked plugins supply capabilities, not a substitute for the latest governing user question.
defaultPrompt: Gunakan reasoning-method-controller: pertahankan pertanyaan akar, pisahkan sumber metode dari sumber objek, dan telusuri literatur dari objek target.
Rekonstruksi argumen ini; tandai perubahan makna, sumber per klaim, teori rival, dan hutang pembuktian.
Bantu proyek coding ini dengan bukti repo/runtime, asumsi yang menentukan desain, probe kecil, dan verifikasi.
